newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iran buys 100,000 tonnes barley - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys 100,000 tonnes barley - traders.

text.p: Iran bought 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin September barley on Tuesday at around $148 per tonne, grain traders said.
The price unusually includes freight and works out at a fob price estimated somewhere near $128 per tonne, depending on origin, the traders said.
Iran usually buys on a fob basis, they said.
Iran tendered for the feed barley on June 9, quoting September shipment. On May 20 it bought 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for August shipment.
The exact price of the latest deal was not confirmed, but traders said offers were seen between $148 and $154 per tonne.
Some traders, however, said the price might finally emerge higher than $150 per tonne.
